result.summary: The page is largely clean and well-aligned. The main visual defect is a rendering glitch in the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen', which appears to show a malformed final letter. A minor contrast concern exists for light gray secondary text. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not reported.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders its final letter as a malformed glyph (it looks like 'Rameı'), suggesting a font or character-encoding rendering problem.
issues.suggestion: Verify the title string uses standard UTF-8 characters and that the app font includes the glyph. Check for a stray or lookalike character in the source data.

issues.description: Secondary text such as delivery fees ('€0.90 delivery'), the rating count '(500+)', and the 'Deliver to' label is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios, especially at small sizes.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for normal text) and keep consistent sizing for readability.
